flows.name: Quest pins at journey stops stay hidden through quest events
steps: Open the world map on Redridge Mountains, where the active journey has stops
Untrack and retrack a watched quest every 2 s six times, which fires QUEST_WATCH_LIST_CHANGED and QUEST_LOG_UPDATE, while capturing the map about every 0.6 s
Blizzard quest pins at the guide's stops stay hidden in every frame; off-route quest pins stay in place
